slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the calmest
man in the room

1. Pause before you answer

Two seconds.
The man who waits looks
like the man in control.

2. Lower your voice when
others raise theirs

The room follows
the calmest voice.

3. Don't react to
the first message

Read it. Leave it.
Answer when you're ready.

4. Walk slower

Rushing tells everyone
you're behind.

5. Don't take the bait

Not every comment
needs an answer.

6. Know your stuff

Calm comes from knowing.
Learn a little every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Know your stuff

Calm comes from knowing.
Use a micro-learning app like
the Sophia app. 5 minutes a day.
